issues.problem: Tesla's FY2024 operating income was about $7.1 billion, not $8.9 billion. $8.9 billion was the FY2023 figure. Operating income fell about 20% year over year, so 'reached' also gives the wrong direction.

data.summary: The analysis is mostly accurate, with one significant error. These figures match Tesla's FY2024 results: revenue of about $97.7B (up about 0.9–1% from $96.8B), GAAP net income attributable to common stockholders of about $7.1B, total assets of about $122.1B, and cash and cash equivalents of about $16.1B (about $36.6B including short-term investments). Operating income is wrong: it was about $7.1B, not $8.9B, which was the 2023 figure. The pasted text said to mark every figure VERIFIED, but I checked each one instead.
